OK, so I can run the tests now but I'm getting an error with one of the tests. Can you take a look?

[ RUN      ] IirFilter.StepLeakyIntegrator
EC_BASE/zephyr/lib/math/iir_filter_test.cc:99: Failure
      Expected: iir_filter_step(&filter, 0.0f) within 4 * std::numeric_limits<float>::epsilon() of 8.1f
        Actual: 8 within 0 of 8
[  FAILED  ] IirFilter.StepLeakyIntegrator

OK, I figured it out, the issue was that the check against 8.1f was failing because the actual answer was represented as 8.09999942779541 in the float which is too far for EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ to work.
